amendments: a correction after the first result keeps this plan, records an amendment with what had been observed, and keeps comparisons interpretable

batch_decision.EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: no game is qualified (inputs missing, replay invalid, untraceable, over budget)
batch_decision.EXPANSION_MIXED: 1 or 2 useful games, or >= 3 useful with an unresolved major inconsistency, or exactly one qualified low-yield game; the limiting factor is named
batch_decision.EXPANSION_SUPPORTED: >= 3 of the 5 games QUALIFIED_USEFUL (each with structural novelty) and no unresolved major inconsistency (no LABEL_POLICY_CONFLICT game, no open review blocker)
batch_decision.per_game_failure: a failed game keeps its exact class (INPUT_REQUIRED, REPLAY_INVALID, TRACING_UNAVAILABLE, ...); valid findings of the other games are preserved; no substitution
batch_decision.separate: neither the model-A diagnostic nor the readiness decision changes the acquisition class; ML_INCONCLUSIVE is not failed acquisition

consistency.audit: ordinary-decode audit of every labelled start has zero length mismatches, non-ordinary decodes and odd starts
consistency.decoders: E starts require agreement of two independent decoders (m68k-disasm walk and the CPU token report), already enforced by `label()`; the accepted-E fraction and rejection classes are reported
consistency.strong_data_conflict: bytes of E code that lie inside an observed DMA-source extent / total E bytes <= 0.005
consistency.weak_conflicts: E bytes that were also ordinary data reads are counted and disclosed; they never gate

control.label_inputs: tas = tas_a only; ctl = ctl_a (primary, all-controller); ctl2 = ctl2_a (player-1-only); tas_b serves determinism
control.limitation: the control is a random-input policy, not a game-playing agent, and often stays near the title or menu. Control depth is reported as the control/TAS executed-PC ratio per game. Yield over the control establishes executed-code acquisition feasibility, not optimality against another intelligent policy and not ML benefit
control.no_game_specific: no per-game script, RAM address, progression shortcut or code-discovery heuristic
control.policy: the SEG-080/081 seeded-input policy ported verbatim (`tb.policy_rows`), delivered as a synthetic `.bk2` that reuses the TAS movie's header, controller and sync settings and replaces only the input log, so ROM, core configuration, frame count, tracing and labelling are identical by construction
control.primary: ctl_a = ALL-CONTROLLER control, seed 1: every controller present in the movie is driven; player 1 uses policy seed 1 (exactly the SEG-081 stream), player k >= 2 an independent stream seeded seed*7919 + 104729*(k-1)
control.secondary: ctl2_a = the SEG-081 player-1-only control (seed 1) as a comparability baseline; only player 1 moves. It replaces SEG-081's seed-2 sensitivity control: the primary class never depends on it (reported as `useful_vs_seed2` in the tool output, i.e. versus the player-1-only control)

disclosures: the primary control drives all controllers with independent seeded streams; the SEG-081 player-1-only control is retained as the comparability baseline
the controls are random-input policies, may stay shallow (reported as the control/TAS executed-PC ratio), and do not bound what an intelligent policy would reach

the policy never presses X/Y/Z/Mode, so six-button games are only partly driven, and player-2 Start can enter two-player modes: both inherited from the SEG-080/081 policy and not corrected (no game-specific logic)
TAS-versus-control yield measures executed-code acquisition feasibility, not ML benefit and not a fair gameplay comparison

the native CDL data flag is blanket: E bytes also read as data are counted and disclosed, never gating; RAM execution disables weak-read supervision under the existing conservative policy (weak-read loss is reported per game)
no source truth exists for these titles: correctness is internal consistency, ROM mapping, decode boundaries and provenance only
NHL '94 is a SEG-077 development candidate with no previous label or registry data
engine independence is approximated by shingle containment and the header publisher / copyright code; true engine ancestry is not measurable here

Windows source-file digests: the bound files are pinned to LF by the existing .gitattributes patterns (tools/segarecomp_genesis_*, tools/*.plan.*, tests/segarecomp_genesis_*_test.py), so a Windows autocrlf checkout cannot change a verified digest

emulator.note: BizHawk 2.9.1 linux-x64 under Mono 6.8, Genplus-gx waterbox core, Xvfb, unprivileged user (SEG-080/081 setup). All five movies name 2.9.1 as the recording emulator or an older release that 2.9.1 replays; replay on 2.9.1 is attempted first and one bounded compatibility investigation per game is allowed. No movie input or emulator setting is altered.

doraemon.title: Doraemon - Yume Dorobou to 7 Nin no Gozans (Japan)

identity.procedure: ROM size + SHA-256 equal the frozen table; the movie-header hash field (an MD5 in BizHawk) equals the local ROM MD5; movie SHA-256, input-log SHA-256, frame count, core, emuVersion and the absence of a savestate equal the frozen table; the ROM header serial/region is recorded privately; any ambiguity (several candidate files, a revision mismatch) rejects the game. ROM SHA-1 values quoted in the request are not used as identity. The local ROM and movie metadata are authoritative; the TASVideos reference ids are candidate identities and are recorded, not trusted.
identity.rom_source: operator-supplied ROMs and movies under games/5-game-exp only; nothing is downloaded or substituted

isolation.checked: SEG-072 corpus manifest (development and sealed), SEG-075/077 candidate lists, SEG-080 Sonic 2 and SEG-081 games. None of the five images is a sealed or reserved-blind member (machine-checked by image SHA-256/SHA-1) or in the development registry. NHL '94 is a SEG-077 development CANDIDATE (title level) whose acquisition tasks were cancelled: no label or registry entry for it exists; its image is the same bytes as the ignored local copy under games/. It is therefore a valid new lineage, disclosed. Developer / engine adjacency is measured by 12-byte code-shingle containment against every registry lineage, every SEG-081 game and every earlier game of this batch.
isolation.rule: an image or lineage id in the sealed/blind set is excluded and reported; containment > 0.30 in either direction against a registry lineage makes the game redundant for the independent-lineage count; games above 0.30 against each other form one lineage cluster

labels.cell_rule: unchanged SEG-072: positive when any I, negative when all D, else masked
labels.no_truth: no source truth exists; source truth and ML predictions never repair labels
labels.overlap: a byte that is both executed and observed as a read / DMA source stays code (E); the overlap is counted and disclosed, never silently treated as exclusive
labels.tiers: E executed I/c strong code; R static reach weak code; H hardware header strong data; M DMA-source strong data; W ordinary ROM read weak nonexclusive data; U unknown/masked

limits.controls: one all-controller primary + the player-1-only comparability baseline
limits.model_a_diagnostic: one HistGradientBoosting fit per arm per fold; at most 16 CPU-hours

coverage: E instruction starts and continuation bytes
cumulative executed-PC growth at 25/50/75/100 % of the emulated time
CPU seconds per extra strong code cell

novelty.primary: N_struct_not_in_control = |(forms U cfg) of the TAS strong labels  minus  the registry  minus  the seed-1 control strong labels| (cfg tuples need a LABELLED target form, so partial coverage cannot create signatures; n-grams and boundary patterns are descriptive; N_struct against the registry alone is reported beside it)
references: SEG-072 qualified development registry (target excluded by construction)
earlier games of this batch (TAS strong labels)
signatures: cfg = (flow kind, target distance class or indirect, source form, target form)
boundary = (form before data, log2 data-run bucket, form after data), taken from the weak variant because strong labels never abut code with data (descriptive only)

arms.B0_sub: noise null: B0 trained on a random 90 % of the base cells (seed 83); no new-game data
arms.C: + primary all-controller control strong labels, five new games
arms.C81: + SEG-081 player-1-only control strong labels, three SEG-081 games
arms.C_all: + control strong labels of the eight games (SEG-081 p1-only, new all-controller)
arms.T: + TAS strong labels, five new games
arms.T81: + SEG-081 TAS strong labels, three SEG-081 games
arms.TW: + TAS strong+weak labels (cell weights), five new games
arms.T_all: + TAS strong labels of the SEG-081 and the new games (eight)
arms.T_matched: + TAS strong labels randomly down-sampled (seed 83) to the primary control's positive and negative cell counts, five new games

model_a.forbidden: reserved blind cohorts, calibration on held-out targets, hyperparameter search, models B/C
model_a.isolation: as SEG-081: new-game lineage ids and image SHA-256 absent from the registry; 12-byte-shingle containment of labelled code runs between a new game and the held-out lineage <= 0.30 in both directions, else the game is withheld from that fold

primary_not_ap: Genesis mean ER (mean over folds of the lineage-max image ER, the SEG-075 definition) and worst-lineage ER
retained-region recall at B35 and B50 (positive cells inside the region) and missed executable instruction starts
boundary-stratum missed cells at B35/B50 (D byte, adjacent D-only, short run)
hard-negative false-positive rate at the fixed operating point
D01, D03 and D07 reported separately
paired per-fold deltas (ER, missed starts, B35/B50 recall) against C and T_matched (volume-matched controls), each judged against the noise floor
reported: pooled AP and AUC (the historical baseline is near-saturated; never a readiness criterion)

model_a.model: SEG-072 model A / M1 HistGradientBoosting (frozen HGB_CONFIG), masked cells excluded; leave-one-lineage-out over every qualified SEG-072 lineage
model_a.noise: noise floor = mean over folds of |ER(B0_sub) - ER(B0)| (data-perturbation spread of the near-saturated baseline). A paired ER delta counts as better / worse only if its magnitude exceeds the floor; the same rule gates `residual_folds`. Deltas inside the floor are reported as undetermined
model_a.operating_point: threshold = the 10th percentile of B0 scores over the fold's positive cells (B0 recall 0.90), every arm scored at it
model_a.runs_when: >= 3 new games qualified (again at the final checkpoint); a diagnostic on the first three qualified games is allowed before the batch ends and is superseded by the final one
model_a.uncertainty: the new games have no source truth: they enter training only; every evaluation fold is a source-backed SEG-072 lineage; incomplete labels are never used as test targets
model_a.verdict: the SEG-081 frozen `ml_verdict` rule on pooled AP for T (continuity), reported beside the ER-based paired deltas; ML_INCONCLUSIVE is a valid outcome

precedence: INPUT_REQUIRED (input missing OR identity mismatch: the game is rejected, not replayed), BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, REPLAY_INVALID, TRACING_UNAVAILABLE, LABEL_POLICY_CONFLICT, then QUALIFIED_*
privacy: ROMs, movies, traces, labels, signatures, screenshots, per-address lists and weights stay in the ignored private directory; committed output is aggregate counts, identities (hashes), digests, hours, and the decision

readiness.MORE_DIVERSITY_NEEDED: no floor failure but at least one pilot criterion unmet; the unmet criteria name the kind of game or evidence missing
readiness.NEURAL_PILOT_JUSTIFIED: no floor failure AND new useful independent lineages >= 3 AND total (eight) >= 5 AND new novel signatures >= 300 AND new strong hard-negative cells >= 300 AND residual folds >= 2 AND provenance_ok
readiness.floor_NEURAL_RETRAINING_NOT_JUSTIFIED: ANY of: new useful independent lineages < 2; new novel signatures < 100; residual folds < 1

inputs.headroom_note: B0's absolute ER is a historical constant of the SEG-072 registry (A ~0.105): it is reported but never a criterion, because it cannot depend on the new data
inputs.independence: a game whose max code-shingle containment (either direction, on the union of control and TAS labelled code runs) against any SEG-072 development lineage exceeds 0.30 adds no independent diversity; the remaining games are clustered by pairwise containment > 0.30; titles are reported separately
inputs.new_hard_negative_cells: strong hard-negative cells in the TAS strong labels of the independent useful NEW games
inputs.new_novel_signatures: |(forms U cfg) signatures of the TAS strong labels of the independent useful NEW games  minus the registry's  minus the SEG-081 games'|
inputs.new_useful_independent_lineages: QUALIFIED_USEFUL new games after the independence rule below (cluster count)
inputs.provenance_ok: no LABEL_POLICY_CONFLICT game, the seg083-v1 snapshot verifies and round-trips
inputs.residual_folds: SEG-072 development folds on which the data-only arm T_all (TAS strong labels of all eight) still has lineage-max ER >= 0.05 and the T_all-over-B0 ER reduction does not exceed the noise floor (below); it measures what extra data did NOT fix, i.e. headroom an architecture could address
inputs.total_useful_independent_lineages: the same over the eight candidates (SEG-081's three included)

readiness.not_required: a significant model-A AP improvement (the baseline is near-saturated)
readiness.pilot_specification_if_justified: separate prospective pilot: one or two difficult development folds, one seed per architecture (B and C-v2), frozen compute limits, source-backed evaluation; full three-seed all-fold retraining needs another operator decision informed by that pilot; not run in SEG-083
readiness.purpose: decide whether a separate, prospective, bounded neural B / C-v2 pilot is worth its compute; the frozen figures of SEG-076 (A ER ~0.105, B ~0.155, C-v2 ~0.127, ~1.6 CPU-hours per C-v2 fit) are historical context, not success thresholds
readiness.scope: all counts come from the NEW BATCH ALONE (five games vs the all-controller control); SEG-081's three games enter only the eight-candidate comparison and the `total_useful_independent_lineages` criterion (their class was judged against the player-1-only control, which is disclosed)

replay.checkpoints: five checkpoints at floor(k*N/6) for k=1..5 plus the final completion state at frame N; each records work-RAM, VRAM, CRAM and VSRAM digests and the cumulative executed-PC / read / edge counts

gate_a.determinism: two traced TAS runs have identical PC-set, read-set, edge-set, CDL digests and checkpoint digests
gate_a.no_perturbation: playback and traced checkpoint digests (RAM, VRAM, CRAM, VSRAM) are identical at every checkpoint; a digest that is "na" (unreadable domain) or a missing domain invalidates the gate
gate_a.played_to_end: playback and traced runs both emulate exactly N frames and the playback run reports the movie FINISHED
gate_a.progression: >= 5 of the 6 checkpoint states have pairwise distinct (RAM, VRAM) digests AND at least 0.5 %% of the run's distinct ROM PCs are first executed in each of >= 3 of the 5 equal movie-time fifths

gate_tracing.controls: frames == N, map mismatch 0, odd PCs 0, reset and vblank PCs executed, self-fetch and CDL bounds

replay.playback: an untraced playback of the movie gives the reference end state (movie FINISHED at frame N) and the unperturbed checkpoint digests
replay.window: the complete movie from power-on (frames = movie input rows)

review: independent plan review before the first trace; reproduction and delta review before acceptance (synthetic CDL fixture, per-game fingerprints, marginal counts, identities, tier provenance, novelty, overlap and lineage isolation, ceilings, privacy, CI)

usefulness.extra_strong_code_cells: TAS strong code-positive cells minus the seed-1 control's (set difference, no truth filter)
usefulness.rule: extra >= 100  OR  (extra >= 25 AND extra >= 0.20 * control cells)
usefulness.sensitivity: the player-1-only control is reported (extra cells, usefulness; tool keys `*_seed2` are renamed `*_p1only` in the output) but never changes the primary class
usefulness.weak_labels: never counted towards the strong-code rule; data-only and mixed-cell yields are reported separately
